biggest_catch: This offer is limited to Utah residents who open at the Herriman branch or through the promotional landing page — and the $250 is forfeited if your account has a negative balance at payout.
catches: Offer valid to individuals without a current Chartway Credit Union membership.
Offer limited to Utah residents who open the account in the Herriman branch or through the promotional landing page only.
Must be 18 years or older to qualify.
One $250 bonus per member; multiple Cash Back accounts are not eligible for additional bonuses.

To earn the $250: (1) qualify for and open a Chartway membership, (2) open a new Cash Back Checking account, (3) perform a minimum of 10 debit card purchases monthly using the Cash Back Checking debit card (excludes ATM transactions, account transfers, and small-value reloads), (4) enroll in electronic statements with a valid email address, and (5) make $500 or more in new money deposits within a monthly cycle into the Cash Back Checking account.

The $250 bonus is deposited into the Cash Back Checking account the calendar month following meeting the qualifications; it will NOT be deposited into any account with a negative balance and will be forfeited in that case.
Offer subject to change or may be discontinued at any time without notice; cannot be combined with any other offer.
For tax purposes, the bonus may be reported to the IRS on Form 1099.
No fixed end date is stated; the page's payout examples reference qualifications met through September (paid by October 16, 2026), suggesting the offer is active through at least September 2026.

steps: Open a Chartway membership and a new Cash Back Checking account via the Herriman branch or the promotional landing page.
Enroll in electronic statements with a valid email address.
Make at least 10 debit card purchases (not ATM or transfer transactions) in the monthly cycle.
Deposit $500+ in new money into the Cash Back Checking account within the same monthly cycle.
Keep the account positive and wait for the $250 to be deposited the following calendar month.
